message: We run a growing retail business across several locations and our current setup is making day-to-day operations feel messy as we expand.
Who are the different users or roles that will use this system?

We have a mix of roles across the branches like cashiers, floor staff, branch managers, and administrators at head office. Everyone has different daily tasks, so a cashier shouldn't have the same access or system view as a manager checking branch performance.
Do you operate from a single location or multiple locations or branches?

We have several branches now and we're expanding fast, which is exactly why things are getting messy. Each location has its own local team, but head office is struggling to get a clear, unified view of what's actually happening on the ground.
How do you currently track your inventory, records, or data, and what problems come up?

Right now, each branch tracks things a bit differently, using a mix of local spreadsheets and fragmented point-of-sale tools. That leads to constant stock discrepancies, missing batch tracking, and endless manual reconciliations at the end of the week. Head office only finds out about shortages or dead stock after the fact, and fixing it takes hours of phone calls and cross-checking.
Walk me through what happens in your core daily workflow from start to finish.

In the morning, the branch managers check overnight deliveries, verify stock counts, and make sure the registers are balanced. Throughout the day, the floor and cashiers handle retail sales and customer transactions, while prescriptions and specific product requests come through our dispensary workflow. At closing, each branch runs an end-of-day reconciliation to match cash and digital payments against sales, and then head office tries to stitch all those separate reports together the next morning.
How do payments or transactions get handled and reconciled today?

Cashiers handle card and cash payments at the register during the day, and then run a closing report on the till. Every evening, the branch manager counts the drawer, matches everything against the POS summary, and emails a spreadsheet to head office. Half the time the numbers don't tie out cleanly, so our admin team spends the next morning chasing down managers to figure out where the discrepancies came from.
What reporting or visibility do you need across the business?

I need head office to see real-time sales, inventory levels, and cash flow for every branch without having to wait for end-of-day emails. Right now, by the time we spot a stock shortage or a recurring cash discrepancy at one location, it's already cost us money or taken hours to track down.
What other tools or systems does this need to work with?

Right now we're using some basic point-of-sale terminals in the stores and standard accounting software at head office, but they don't talk to each other properly. Whatever comes in needs to integrate smoothly with those so we aren't forcing our staff to learn a completely foreign setup or double-enter data all day.
